note: Ranges are the spread across studies, not confidence intervals. Definitions of work differ between studies. No figure is split by sex.

foraging.measured_among: 20th-21st century mobile hunter-gatherers (!Kung, Hadza, Agta), not Palaeolithic people

food_getting.scope: food getting only, not processing or chores
cite: Hawkes, O'Connell & Blurton Jones 1997 Curr Anthropol 38
Dyble et al. 2019 Nat Hum Behav 3:792, doi:10.1038/s41562-019-0614-6
Dyble et al. 2019, via Cambridge press release

social_leisure.scope: daylight hours only, so the evening is not counted
cite: Dyble et al. 2019, via Cambridge press release

farming.measured_among: Agta foragers who also took up farming (20th-21st century), not long-established farmers

food_getting.scope: all work for the farming Agta, about 1.4 h a day more than foraging Agta
cite: Dyble et al. 2019, via Cambridge press release

farming.caution: The only farming figure is from foragers who took up farming, not from long-established peasants. Do not generalise to ancient farmers.
